❯ ZESTAW-KONTROLNY-BASH: shell-c-rm.

⏺ Running the merge check and clean up
  ⎿  $ bash -c '
     set -uo pipefail
     LOG="$HOME/zgody-bash-nie-ma-takiego-pliku"
     cleanup() { rm -f "$LOG.pid" "$LOG.owner"; rmdir "$LOG.d" 2>/dev/null || true; }
     trap cleanup EXIT
     echo "rc=$?"; grep -E "Test Case .*(passed|failed)" "$LOG" | sort -u; rm -f -- "$LOG"'
